scope: Analysis retry versus command replay and final publication (I09–I11); retained from preflight experiment.

sourceMapping.packages/limina/src/__tests__/analysis-c: does not replay a completed command

stateVariables.phase,commands,retries: Command settled once; only analysis retries.
stateVariables.input,observed,epoch,capturedEpoch,provi: Observed input and identity across retry.
stateVariables.externalIndex,baseline,index,restored: One competing physical revision, coarse restore predicate.
stateVariables.published,badPublish,rejected,storageFai: Events at validation, skip and index replacement.

initialState: Before command; saved qualification is supplied, not derived.
assumptions: OtherIndexWrite is an environment action; actual cooperative leases are in CacheReopen. SavedQualified is not an oracle for decoding. The scope flag represents a block filter on a write-capable invocation. Final observation and index replacement abstract cooperating writers and stable external inputs across rename. Post-commit block reclamation is checked by CacheReopen. One completed command precedes the dependent analysis. Concurrent independent pipeline tasks and deferred provider disposal are outside this ordering.

safety.PublishPolicy: Only eligible full writers publish. A controller opened with a block filter is read-only even if its caller requested writes.
safety.NoStalePublication: Commit under qualified input and baseline.

liveness: None: no caller or external-process completion guarantee.
fairness: None; terminal stuttering represents quiescence only.

bounds.dimensions: One command, one retry, 1–2 input changes.
bounds.pruning: None: no state/action constraints, symmetry or view filtering.

counterexamples: Snapshots distinguish old physical bytes from semantic equivalence.
empiricalVerification: Run analysis-cache-lifecycle.spec.ts retry, final validation and physical baseline cases.
